Orient 1 is a digital learning platform for Dominican College of Tarlac (DCT) students. This application provides lessons about DCT History, Student Life and values, along with assessments and 360 Campus View. The application functions both online and offline. Lessons and assessments can be accessed offline, but an internet connection is required for the 360 Campus view.
We are a team of developers dedicated to building user-friendly applications designed to address real-world challenges. Our work aims to provide practical and effective solutions.
